headline: Local Residents Confused As Neighbor Renames His One-Bedroom Apartment 'The Republic of Bedroom' During Housing Dispute
body:
“I woke up yesterday and found a massive plywood plaque over the door claiming he has officially seceded from the society’s maintenance committee,” said a local apartment security guard, adjusting his cap. 

“The guy even tried to demand a visa from the delivery rider who showed up with his pepperoni pizza, claiming the hallway is now a contested international border,” noted a frazzled food delivery partner. 

“I honestly don’t mind the new flag he hung from the balcony, but he insists that my request for the WiFi password constitutes an act of illegal border infiltration,” remarked a confused college student living in the unit next door. 

“He started charging me a ‘foreign trade tariff’ just to borrow a cup of sugar, and honestly, at this point, it’s easier to just go to the store than to negotiate a bilateral trade agreement with a guy in his pajamas,” grumbled a nearby grocery shopkeeper.
caption: The geopolitical crisis no one saw coming is happening right next door. Would you accept a visa to borrow some salt? 🌍🏠 #HousingDispute #NeighborhoodDrama #Diplomacy #ApartmentLiving (satire)
igHook: Would you pay a tariff to borrow sugar from your neighbor?
imagePrompt: A photorealistic shot of a mundane apartment building hallway with several doors in a row, focusing on one door that has a small, hand-painted wooden sign hanging crookedly from the handle.
